operator_direction.scope: separately identified zero-I/O recovery attempt after the exact next-gate artifact was recovered; no physical authority

unchanged_scientific_contract.changes: none; the split, three models, gain cases, nuisances, sensitivity list, 18-code usefulness gate, terminal order, and no-I/O authority are inherited exactly

source_recovery.claim_boundary: exact recorded artifact identity recovered; no clean-source-revision claim

recovery_attempt_clarifications.purpose: deterministic executable detail needed to evaluate, not alter, the already frozen model and validation semantics
recovery_attempt_clarifications.stage5_support_construction: for each complete settled Stage 5 dwell, reconstruct the first two non-overlapping 600-accepted-D14-interval supports from raw cumulative D8 snapshots and count rows; require exact D14 association, one capture session, one DAC epoch, valid flags, and count arithmetic
recovery_attempt_clarifications.settling_boundary_cases: one interval before the 900-second boundary is rejected; exact-boundary and one-second-above starts are independently reconstructed from fresh 600-second supports
recovery_attempt_clarifications.frequency_observation: integer count error c maps to closed [(2c-1)/1200,(2c+1)/1200] Hz
recovery_attempt_clarifications.constant_model: intersect every Stage 5 support's exact equilibrium-code interval at each fixed gain case
recovery_attempt_clarifications.slow_drift_model: use e(t)=e_ref+d*(t-t_ref), exact D14-sequence elapsed hours, t_ref at the midpoint of first and last support midpoints, and d in [-1.91,+1.91] codes/hour; retain the complete correlated feasible projection
recovery_attempt_clarifications.history_model: outbound_or_anchor segments are centre_1, lower_interior_1, lower_endpoint, centre_2, upper_interior_1, and upper_endpoint; return segments are lower_interior_2, upper_interior_2, and final_safe_centre; one durable base plus a common return offset bounded to [-8,+8] codes must explain both groups
recovery_attempt_clarifications.same_code_perturbation: apply +1 and -1 integer count separately to both supports of one complete repeated return segment at a time; never apply it as a permanent response offset
recovery_attempt_clarifications.held_out_prediction: use all 52 Attempt 4 selected 600-second supports only after identification; a support is covered when its closed half-count observation interval intersects the model prediction interval; require 52/52 coverage
recovery_attempt_clarifications.slow_drift_holdout: cross-run prediction fails closed because independent capture sessions have no frozen shared drift origin
recovery_attempt_clarifications.history_holdout: carry the full [-8,+8]-code history offset into every held-out prediction rather than selecting a favorable direction after outcomes
recovery_attempt_clarifications.leave_one_out: remove both supports of one complete Stage 5 dwell, never one adjacent support
recovery_attempt_clarifications.gain_aggregation: minimum, nominal, and maximum fixed-gain cases must each pass; no averaging or nominal-only selection
recovery_attempt_clarifications.temperature: report both complete nearby-air ranges without fitting a coefficient or creating a hard applicability gate
recovery_attempt_clarifications.terminal_rule: identity or executable model-binding failure is invalid; otherwise any empty, held-out-failing, sensitivity-failing, or wider-than-18-code case is not observable; observability requires all ten parent gates
